Figure 60 Varying Impact of Features on Student Motivation 
By analysing the data collected as displayed on Figure 60, an assessment can be 
made on the effectiveness of the various gamified features. Gems appear to be 
the most effective feature, with the highest number of students reporting a 
“Strong positive” response to motivation. This may indicative that digital 
rewards have an immediate impact on student motivation, potentially because it 
shows a clear indicator of progress and success. 
Conversely, the completive leaderboard and achievement features seem to have 
positive yet moderate affect, with a significant portion of results falling under the 
“Positive” category. Leader boards and achievements are designed to reward
